record.paper_title: THE LYAPIN’S NOTEBOOK: A COLLECTION OF UNSOLVED PROBLEMS IN SEMIGROUP THEORY
record.context_brief: General criteria for periodic-group power-semigroup embedding
record.original_question: Find general embeddability criteria, necessary and/or sufficient, for a semigroup to embed into the power semigroup over a periodic group.

evidence.quote:
Problem 5.5. (S.G. Bershadsky, S.I. Kublanovsky) Find general embeddability criteria (necessary
and/or sufficient conditions) for a semigroup to be embeddable into the power semigroup over a
periodic group.
           Some partial conditions were obtained in [4], [3]

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a group $G$, the power semigroup $P(G)$ is the semigroup whose elements are the nonempty subsets of $G$, with multiplication defined by $A\cdot B=\{ab:a\in A,\,b\in B\}$ for $A,B\subseteq G$. A group $G$ is called periodic if every element of $G$ has finite order. A semigroup $S$ is said to be embeddable into $P(G)$ if there exists an injective semigroup homomorphism $S\hookrightarrow P(G)$.

It is known that not every semigroup embeds into the power semigroup of some periodic group (while every semigroup embeds into the power semigroup of a free group, and every commutative semigroup embeds into the power semigroup of an abelian group).

Problem: Find general embeddability criteria — necessary and/or sufficient conditions on a semigroup $S$ — for $S$ to be embeddable into the power semigroup $P(G)$ for some periodic group $G$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed in a collection of unsolved problems in semigroup theory and is attributed to S.G. Bershadsky and S.I. Kublanovsky. Only partial conditions are known (e.g., for completely regular semigroups, inversion and periodicity suffice). No general necessary and sufficient criterion has been reported, so the problem appears to remain open.
